name: shipyard
description: SDLC pipeline plugins for Claude Code — from raw idea to shipped software.

plugins.name: prd
plugins.description: Turn a raw idea into a structured PRD through a guided, one-question-at-a-time interview.

plugins.name: kanban
plugins.description: Turn a PRD into vertical-slice tickets and create them on a real board (GitHub or Jira).

plugins.name: planning
plugins.description: Per-ticket collaborative planning — /spec aligns on what done means; /plan produces an executable implementation plan.

plugins.name: qa
plugins.description: Verification stage — run the test suite plus real per-criterion E2E against a branch and post a tiered verdict with evidence.

plugins.name: dev
plugins.description: Autonomous implementation stage — executes an approved plan test-first in an isolated worktree and hands a structured report to QA.

plugins.name: ship
plugins.description: Conductor stage — drive one planned ticket through the autonomous dev ⇄ QA loop to Awaiting Review.

plugins.name: pr
plugins.description: Pipeline exit — open the pull request for an approved ticket and move it to PR Open.

plugins.name: dashboard
plugins.description: Visual pipeline dashboard — local web UI for tickets, stages, per-stage stats, and board actions.

plugins.name: forge
plugins.description: Intent-driven autonomous dev loop — approve an Intent.md, get a PR. Board-free; no other plugin required.
